scope: 12 synthetic Validation-only tasks. No Development task, source version, anchor, prompt bundle or visual artifact is eligible for this run.
acceptancePolicy: Use the evaluator v2 policy semantics, but freeze a Validation-specific policy before the model run; do not apply Development's post-hoc policy file.
reviewRequirement: Two named independent reviewers must approve every source/evidence/claim package before any Validation model call.
stoppingRule: Run the frozen Validation cohort once. Do not tune prompts, model parameters, tasks, sources, assertions or evaluator after observing outputs.
